sources.title: GitHub - k0sti/nomen: Nostr-native agent memory system
sources.snippet: Scoped memory for AI agents on Nostr. Nomen gives AI agents persistent, searchable, shareable memory using Nostr as the sync layer. Memory is scoped by visibility — from public knowledge to agent-private reasoning — and signed with the agent's keypair. No vendor lock-in, no central database. Your memory travels with your keys.
